m: पुड् cl. 6. P. पुडति, to leave, quit, Dhātup. xxviii, 90; cl. 1. P. पोडति, to grind, pound, ix, 38 (v.l. for मुट्).
a: पुड् — {c6c} P. 1 To leave, quit, abandon. --2 To dismiss. --3 To emit, send forth --4 To discover.

s: i mardde । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-paraMsakaM-sew .) paYcamasvarI । i, puRqyate । marddaScarRIkaraRam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: mardane BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew idit । puRqati apuRqIt ।
